item.title: refactor(plugins): derive private config types from schemas (#130414)
item.summary: refactor(plugins): derive private config types from schemas (#130414) * refactor(plugins): derive private config types from schemas * test(ci): make directory binding proof deterministic Replace race-prone child-cwd polling with a synchronous fixture retarget after the real chdir, preserving the full worker and security assertions. Shrink the assertion-safety baseline for the three casts removed by the schema cleanup.
